title: Chopper
description: A Modpack that strives on giving the best performance with enhanced visuals.
body:
The **Chopper** modpack strives to give the best performance by using a plethera of optimization mods while also giving great visual clarity and quality of life from mods, resource packs, and 
shaders. 

**Now With Controller Support!**
